title: Cannoli 1.0 — Day 1 patch
body:
- Season 11 is live on the new National Dex+ scaling, rules synced (feature)
- Pick which week a battle counts for — play ahead or make up matches (feature)
- Nickname your Pokemon from the new Manage Roster panel (feature)
- Unified draft-pool search by name, type, move, ability or cost (feature)
- Watch every Season 9–11 replay in-app (feature)
- Upload a custom team logo (feature)
- Complete National Dex+ types and learnsets — tier list and coverage fixed (fix)
- Edit tera captains and tera types any time during the season (fix)
- Matchup Center is public — scout without signing in (improvement)
- Animated login and replay backgrounds, 3D sidebar gems (improvement)
- Smoother recovery after updates, with new error tracking (improvement)
